row.notes: myteam-g2: Looks up the named team modifier (name string at comp+0x310) for the team (own key or *team_key_opt) in the modifier list at comp+0x2f8->+0x2c8 (0x30 stride), clamps to its min/max (floats +0xc/+0x10 or +0x7c) and returns the float multiplier (default 1.0). Used by sponsor cards and goal panels to display modified rewards.

verify.notes: V9501 Looks up modifier list at comp+0x2f8->+0x2c8 (0x30 stride), name key comp+0x310, clamps with vmin/vmax (floats +0xc/+0x10 or +0x7c), default 1.0.
